gaps.explanation: The schedule is 12,276 above the statement. Statement p4 Road Fund column: TOTAL RECEIPTS 447,421 (Intergovernmental 446,928 + Local 493). It prints 'Sale of surplus' 12,276 under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES), so the statement's governmental receipts total is 1,870,204. The Road Fund budgetary comparison schedule (p9) prints Local 12,769 inside RECEIPTS, so its TOTAL RECEIPTS is 459,697 (446,928 + 12,769). Detail follows p9: Local 493 + Sale of surplus 12,276 (split from Local 12,769) in section revenue. Detail revenue total 1,882,480 - 12,276 = 1,870,204. The two printed pages classify the same 12,276 differently (receipt on p9, other financing source on p4). It is not a duplicate or an extraction error, so there is nothing to fix.
